purpose: Post-hoc evaluation of final complete scoring configurations; source-only threshold selection
objective: Maximize selection coverage, then allow coverage, then upper threshold, then prefer smaller lower threshold
decision: Allow p < low, block p > high, otherwise escalate, including unavailable scores
confirmation: Evaluate the source-selected policy once without retuning, retaining failed confirmation
test: Evaluate the same selected thresholds without tuning on test labels
